rdc_plot_q_scores.description: Template for quality score for correlation of observed and calculated RDCs per RDC vector type.

r2.descritopn: Linear correlation coefficients between observed and calculated RDC values: 1.0 - sum( (Dexp - Dcalc)^2 ) / sum( (Dexp - <Dexp>)^2 ), where Dexp is observed RDC value, Dcalc is calculated RDC value, and <Dexp> is mean value of observed RDCs.

Cornilescu_Q.descritopn: Cornilescu's RDC quality score: sqrt( sum( (Dexp - Dcalc)^2 ) / sum( Dexp^2 )) where Dexp is observed RDC value, Dcalc is calculated RDC value.

Clore_Q.descritopn: Clore's RDC quality score: sqrt( sum( (Dexp - Dcalc)^2 ) / (N * Da^2 * (4 + 3 * eta^2) / 5)) where N is the number of RDCs assessed, Da is the axial component (Dmax * Szz), and eta is the rhombicity ((Syy - Sxx) / Szz).

information.description: The object provides information about set of input sources that includes the NMR restraints file and atomic coordinates file.

sequence_alignments.description: The object provides sequence alignments of data loops in the input source file and sequence alignement between different input sources.

model_poly_seq_vs_coordinate.description: The object provides sequence alignment between sequence of the NMR data and sequence of the coordinates.

model_poly_seq_vs_nmr_poly_seq.description: The object provides sequence alignment between sequence of the coordinates and sequence of the NMR data.

model_poly_seq_vs_mr_topology.description: The object provides sequence alignment between sequence of the coordinates and sequence of topology.

model_poly_seq_vs_mr_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between sequence of the coordinates and sequence of restraints.

model_poly_seq_vs_spectral_peak.description: The object provides sequence alignment between sequence of the coordinates and sequence of spectral peak lists.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_model_poly_seq.description: The object provides sequence alignment between sequence of the NMR data and sequence of the coordinates.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_chem_shift.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for assigned chemical shifts.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_dist_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for distance restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_dihed_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for dihedral angle restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_rdc_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for RDC restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_spectral_peak.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for assigned spectral peak lists written in NEF (NMR exchange format) compatible category, for example '_Peak_row_format' for NMR-STAR and '_nef_peak' for NEF.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_spectral_peak_alt.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for assigned spectral peak lists written in NMR-STAR cannonical catgories, for example '_Peak', '_Peak_general_char', '_Peak_char', and '_Assigned_peak_chem_shift'.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_noepk_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for NOESY peak volume restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_jcoup_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for scalar J-coupling restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_rdc_raw_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for RDC raw data.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_csa_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for CSA restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_ddc_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for direct dipolar coupling restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_hvycs_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for carbon/nitrogen chemical shift restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_procs_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for proton chemical shift restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_csp_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for chemical shift perturbations.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_auto_relax_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for auto-relaxtion (inc. PRE) restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_heteronucl_noe_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for heteronuclear NOE data.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_heteronucl_t1_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for heteronuclear T1 relaxation data.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_heteronucl_t2_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for heteronuclear T2 relaxation data.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_heteronucl_t1r_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for heteronuclear T1rho relaxation data.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_order_param_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for order parameters.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_coupling_const_data.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for coupling constant data.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_ccr_d_csa_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for dipole-CSA cross correlation restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_ccr_dd_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for dipole-dipole cross correlation restraints.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_fchiral_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for floating chiral stereo assigments.

nmr_poly_seq_vs_other_restraint.description: The object provides sequence alignment between the representative sequence of the NMR data and sequence in data loops for other restraints.

chain_assignments.description: The object provides chain assignments between the NMR data and the coordinates.

output_statistics.description: This array provides statistics and validation metrics of output NMR data file.

diamagnetic.destriction: Diamagnetism of the molecular assembly, except for Oxygen.

disulfide_bond.description: Whether the molecular assembly has any disulfide bound.

other_bond.description: Whether the molecular assembly has any other bound, except for covalent, hydrogen, disulfide bounds.

cyclic_polymer.description: Whether the molecular assembly has an entity having cyclic linkage, for example cyclic peptide.

status.description: Status code of the input source file.

error.description: The object provides error messages with diagnostic information. If there is a error, wwPDB OneDep file upload failes.

warning.description: The object provides warning messages with diagnostic information. Even with the warning, wwPDB OneDep file upload will succeed.

corrected_warning.description: The object provides warning messages that were initially reported, but were remediated by subsequent diagnostic processes. This is audit history for the remediations.
